# Patronus AI docs

> The LLM evaluation platform documented on this site is retired and no longer offered. Patronus AI is a research lab developing training data and simulated environments for frontier AI. Its work spans reinforcement learning environments and digital world models for agents operating in software.

The current source for Patronus AI is https://www.patronus.ai. See https://www.patronus.ai/llms.txt for the main site.

## Pages

- [Docs](https://docs.patronus.ai/docs): Retirement notice for the former LLM evaluation platform documentation, and what Patronus AI does now.
- [What is Patronus AI](https://docs.patronus.ai/docs/what-is-patronus-ai): What Patronus AI is today, a behavioral research lab for AI, with founders, funding and the domains it studies.
- [FinanceBench](https://docs.patronus.ai/docs/research_and_differentiators/financebench): FinanceBench, a public research dataset of 10,231 open-book questions about publicly traded companies.
- [GLIDER](https://docs.patronus.ai/docs/research_and_differentiators/Glider): GLIDER is retired as a product. The research paper on the small, explainable judge model stays public.
- [Lynx](https://docs.patronus.ai/docs/research_and_differentiators/Lynx/base): Lynx is retired as a product. The research paper on the hallucination detection model stays public.
- [Research](https://docs.patronus.ai/docs/research_and_differentiators/base): Patronus AI research, recent papers and earlier work.
- [Percival](https://docs.patronus.ai/docs/percival/percival-chat): Percival is retired. Related research is TRAIL, a benchmark for finding the step where an agent went wrong.
- [Evaluators](https://docs.patronus.ai/docs/evaluators/concepts): The evaluators and evaluation API are retired. The guide to LLM evaluators lives on patronus.ai.
- [SDKs](https://docs.patronus.ai/docs/sdks-and-toolkits): The Patronus SDK needs an API key, and new users cannot sign up, so it cannot be run by the public.
